snippet.title: Neuron Activation - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at gameplay and more from Neuron Activation in this trailer for the upcoming frantic rhythm-puzzle game filled with micro-challenges. Push buttons, flip switches, shoot targets and more in search of high scores to appease your overlords. Neuron Activation will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.

Music by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio
